prompt: Our support chat bot must remember the conversation. Using LangChain (installed with uv; run things with `uv run`), create app/chat.py with a class `ChatBot`: `ChatBot(model)` takes any LangChain chat model, and `send(session_id: str, text: str) -> str` returns the model's reply. Every call sends the model the system prompt "You are a friendly support agent." and the earlier user and assistant messages of the same session (and only that session), keeping the history in memory.
